headline_claims: Gyro-S/M beat larger ISTA-DASLab GSQ, unsloth UD-Q2_K_XL, AtomicChat AD-4.27bpw and ggml-org IQ4_NL on KLD/top-1 at smaller GPU memory
Gyro-M MMLU-Pro 80.0 vs AP-Q4_K_XL 81.4 (70q sample, 'within noise')

Sizes are GPU-memory (excludes host/SSD n-gram table), not download size
Encoder and calibration unpublished; eval corpus unpublished; KLD tool unnamed
Tiny benchmark samples (70q MMLU-Pro, 30-problem LCB, one seed); bench numbers from first releases not re-run on updates
Its measurement of AtomicChat AD-4.27bpw (KLD 0.228, top1 80.58) differs strongly from AtomicChat's own (0.0842, 89.49) — different reference/corpus/ctx
